A '''[[Cloning/Legends|clone]]''' was stationed in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Judiciary Central Detention Center]] in the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Deception" />

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disguised himself as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] and infiltrated the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center to uncover a plot to assassinate [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], this clone was working in the detention facility's morgue.<ref name="Deception" />

After the undercover [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] along with prisoners [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] started a prison riot in the mess hall, they managed to evade the prison [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|guards]] and attempted to use the morgue to escape, hiding inside coffins that would later be sent to the cremation center. This clone along with two others were working in the morgue when the incident happened, involuntarily helping the prisoners escape the facility by sending the coffins to be cremated.<ref name="Deception" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The clone first appeared in the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] television series' fourth season, titled "[[Deception]]." He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], the actor who portrays all of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the series.
